Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

You support your offer with individual cost shares; it seems recovery of specific costs is central to your position. Please share your cost-breakdown XLSX so we can review those elements against our purchase history and establish a transparent pricing basis. How can greater contract certainty translate into a more competitive price?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Using your own cost shares (AS-14404 45%, LCI-C 5%, PPI-C2431 38%) and the latest six-month index moves (AS-14404 -0.3% (idx:AS-14404@2026-03, idx:AS-14404@2026-09), LCI-C +1.7% (idx:LCI-C@2025-12, idx:LCI-C@2026-06), PPI-C2431 +9.7% (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-02, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08)), your cost increase comes to about +3.6% of the price, not +4.5%. Our current contract passes PPI-C2431 on at 80% weight (ctr:4600070740#3.2), while your quote states it is 38% of your cost; that clause has already raised our price by 11% this year. Other suppliers currently quote this part at about EUR 5.45. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.77 per unit, no index clause, 45 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.76 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.74 per unit, no index clause, 14 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We appreciate the commitment to 23,700 units over 24 months, which enables us to reduce our price to EUR 5.60 per unit. Please note that for a 24-month contract, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage material volatility, as a fixed price over this extended period is not feasible. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Please send us the competing offer you mentioned.

Our current offer is a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit. As an alternative, we also present a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

Your repeated emphasis on indexation suggests that protection from material volatility is central to your willingness to commit. We want a durable agreement in which the base price reflects the risk transferred through indexation. What base-price reduction can you authorise in exchange for that protection and faster payment?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Our recent orders for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled were at 5.26, 5.84 per 1 (po:4500014292-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10). As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +3.6%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.84 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 5% deadband), 14 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.86 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 5% deadband), 30 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.84 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 3% deadband), 14 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We agree that faster payment warrants a concession, and we value your commitment to a 24-month volume. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. In exchange for 14-day payment terms and the AS-14404 index clause, we can reduce our base price to EUR 5.40 per unit. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Therefore, our modified proposal contains a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Please note that this proposal remains valid for 30 days. We are always happy to work with you and look forward to continuing our partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

You tie your concession to faster payment and index protection, and explicitly value a longer commitment—it seems commercial predictability matters as much as the headline price. We want to build the partnership on a transparent base price that gives proper credit for that predictability. What scope for a further base-price reduction can you substantiate by sharing your itemised cost breakdown in an Excel workbook?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +3.6%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.92 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 5% deadband), 14 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have also reviewed your forecast data; however, it does not alter our calculation for this specific part. Regarding your request for an itemised cost breakdown, please understand that we do not share detailed internal cost structures beyond the material share already provided. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We maintain our offer of a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
